title: Performance Benchmark
text: rule blocks. base uses hand-written tests, chk uses chk, checkmate uses checkmate (three different idioms), mixed combines last two shown README. pass heavy_args, error path timed.
code: heavy_args <- list(   name = "model_01",   threads = 4L,   seed = 42L,   arg_1 = 1,   arg_2 = 2,   arg_3 = 3,   arg_4 = 4,   arg_5 = 5,   lower = 0,   upper = 10,   tolerance = 0.5,   verbose = TRUE )  # Every candidate has exactly these 12 formals; only the body changes. make_fit <- function(expr) {   f <- function(     name,     threads,     seed,     arg_1,     arg_2,     arg_3,     arg_4,     arg_5,     lower,     upper,     tolerance,     verbose   ) {     NULL   }   body(f) <- expr   f }  # Compile one block of rules twice: into an argvet container, and into the # body of a plain function. This keeps both arms perfectly comparable. compile_rules <- function(rules) {   block <- substitute(rules)   validator <- eval(call("make_arg_validator", block))   inline <- make_fit(as.call(c(     list(as.name("{")),     as.list(block)[-1L],     list(quote(arg_1 + arg_2))   )))   list(validator = validator, inline = inline) }  median_us <- function(mb) {   s <- summary(mb)   stats::setNames(s$median, as.character(s$expr)) }  bm_times <- 200L base_rules <- compile_rules({   if (!is.character(name) || length(name) != 1L || is.na(name)) {     stop("name")   }   if (!nzchar(name)) {     stop("name")   }   if (!is.integer(threads) || length(threads) != 1L || is.na(threads)) {     stop("threads")   }   if (threads < 1L || threads > 64L) {     stop("threads")   }   if (!is.integer(seed) || length(seed) != 1L || is.na(seed)) {     stop("seed")   }   if (seed < 0L) {     stop("seed")   }   for (v in list(arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, arg_5)) {     if (!is.numeric(v) || length(v) != 1L || is.na(v)) {       stop("arg")     }     if (v < lower || v > upper) stop("arg")   }   if (!is.numeric(lower) || length(lower) != 1L || is.na(lower)) {     stop("lower")   }   if (!is.numeric(upper) || length(upper) != 1L || is.na(upper)) {     stop("upper")   }   if (lower >= upper) {     stop("lower/upper")   }   if (!is.numeric(tolerance) || length(tolerance) != 1L || is.na(tolerance)) {     stop("tolerance")   }   if (tolerance <= 0) {     stop("tolerance")   }   if (!is.logical(verbose) || length(verbose) != 1L || is.na(verbose)) {     stop("verbose")   }   if (arg_1 + arg_2 + arg_3 + arg_4 + arg_5 > 10 * upper) stop("sum") })  chk_rules <- compile_rules({   chk::chk_string(name)   chk::chk_integer(threads)   chk::chk_gte(threads, 1L)   chk::chk_lte(threads, 64L)   chk::chk_whole_number(seed)   chk::chk_gte(seed, 0L)   for (v in list(arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, arg_5)) {     chk::chk_number(v)     chk::chk_gte(v, lower)     chk::chk_lte(v, upper)   }   chk::chk_number(lower)   chk::chk_number(upper)   chk::chk_number(tolerance)   chk::chk_gt(tolerance, 0)   chk::chk_flag(verbose) })  cm_rules <- compile_rules({   checkmate::assertString(name)   checkmate::assertInt(threads)   checkmate::assertInt(threads, lower = 1L)   checkmate::assertInt(threads, upper = 64L)   checkmate::assertCount(seed)   for (v in list(arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, arg_5)) {     checkmate::assertNumber(v)     checkmate::assertNumber(v, lower = lower)     checkmate::assertNumber(v, upper = upper)   }   checkmate::assertNumber(lower)   checkmate::assertNumber(upper)   checkmate::assertNumber(tolerance)   checkmate::assertNumber(tolerance, lower = 0)   checkmate::assertFlag(verbose) })  cm_assert_rules <- compile_rules({   checkmate::assert(     checkmate::checkString(name),     checkmate::checkInt(threads),     checkmate::checkInt(threads, lower = 1L),     checkmate::checkInt(threads, upper = 64L),     checkmate::checkCount(seed),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_1),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_1, lower = lower),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_1, upper = upper),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_2),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_2, lower = lower),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_2, upper = upper),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_3),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_3, lower = lower),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_3, upper = upper),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_4),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_4, lower = lower),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_4, upper = upper),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_5),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_5, lower = lower),     checkmate::checkNumber(arg_5, upper = upper),     checkmate::checkNumber(lower),     checkmate::checkNumber(upper),     checkmate::checkNumber(tolerance),     checkmate::checkNumber(tolerance, lower = 0),     checkmate::checkFlag(verbose),     combine = "and"   ) })  cm_qassert_rules <- compile_rules({   checkmate::qassert(name, "s1")   checkmate::qassert(threads, "i1")   checkmate::qassert(threads, "i1[1,64]")   checkmate::qassert(seed, "i1[0,Inf]")   for (v in list(arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, arg_5)) {     checkmate::qassert(v, "n1")     checkmate::qassert(v, "n1[0,10]")   }   checkmate::qassert(lower, "n1")   checkmate::qassert(upper, "n1")   checkmate::qassert(tolerance, "n1")   checkmate::qassert(tolerance, "n1(0,Inf]")   checkmate::qassert(verbose, "b1") })  mixed_rules <- compile_rules({   chk::chk_string(name)   chk::chk_integer(threads)   checkmate::assertCount(seed)   for (v in list(arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, arg_5)) {     chk::chk_number(v)     checkmate::assertNumber(v, lower = lower, upper = upper)   }   chk::chk_number(lower)   chk::chk_number(upper)   checkmate::assertNumber(tolerance, lower = 0)   chk::chk_flag(verbose) }) validate_base <- base_rules$validator validate_chk <- chk_rules$validator validate_checkmate <- cm_rules$validator validate_mixed <- mixed_rules$validator  f_none <- make_fit(quote(arg_1 + arg_2)) f_base_inline <- base_rules$inline f_chk_inline <- chk_rules$inline f_checkmate_inline <- cm_rules$inline f_checkmate_assert_inline <- cm_assert_rules$inline f_checkmate_qassert_inline <- cm_qassert_rules$inline f_mixed_inline <- mixed_rules$inline  f_base_container <- make_fit(quote({   validate_base()   arg_1 + arg_2 })) f_chk_container <- make_fit(quote({   validate_chk()   arg_1 + arg_2 })) f_checkmate_container <- make_fit(quote({   validate_checkmate()   arg_1 + arg_2 })) f_mixed_container <- make_fit(quote({   validate_mixed()   arg_1 + arg_2 }))  # Two idiomatic ways of consuming the list returned by a validator. f_base_used <- make_fit(quote({   args <- validate_base()   args$arg_1 + args$arg_2 })) f_base_writeback <- make_fit(quote({   list2env(validate_base(), envir = environment())   arg_1 + arg_2 })) f_chk_writeback <- make_fit(quote({   list2env(validate_chk(), envir = environment())   arg_1 + arg_2 }))

code: mb_engines <- microbenchmark(   base_inline = do.call(f_base_inline, heavy_args),   base_container = do.call(f_base_container, heavy_args),   chk_inline = do.call(f_chk_inline, heavy_args),   chk_container = do.call(f_chk_container, heavy_args),   checkmate_inline = do.call(f_checkmate_inline, heavy_args),   checkmate_container = do.call(f_checkmate_container, heavy_args),   mixed_inline = do.call(f_mixed_inline, heavy_args),   mixed_container = do.call(f_mixed_container, heavy_args),   times = bm_times,   unit = "us" ) print(mb_engines) #> Unit: microseconds #>                 expr    min      lq      mean  median      uq      max neval #>          base_inline  6.790  7.6665  8.365065  8.0120  8.4575   20.400   200 #>       base_container 17.356 18.3980 19.989780 19.0535 19.9395  104.716   200 #>           chk_inline 31.857 33.6800 35.978690 34.5015 36.3695   62.393   200 #>        chk_container 38.677 40.5555 43.094790 41.6620 43.3090  100.239   200 #>     checkmate_inline 65.327 67.1200 85.151680 68.5320 71.3710 2842.807   200 #>  checkmate_container 70.505 72.9385 77.300125 74.2005 76.7695  147.038   200 #>         mixed_inline 28.672 30.2850 51.793835 31.0210 32.2580 3933.549   200 #>      mixed_container 34.441 35.9835 37.593145 36.7350 37.6310   50.074   200 ggplot2::autoplot(mb_engines) m <- median_us(mb_engines) engines <- c("base", "chk", "checkmate", "mixed") inline <- unname(m[paste0(engines, "_inline")]) container <- unname(m[paste0(engines, "_container")]) delta <- container - inline print(   data.frame(     engine = engines,     inline_us = round(inline, 2),     container_us = round(container, 2),     delta_us = round(delta, 2),     delta_pct = round(100 * delta / inline, 1)   ),   row.names = FALSE ) #>     engine inline_us container_us delta_us delta_pct #>       base      8.01        19.05    11.04     137.8 #>        chk     34.50        41.66     7.16      20.8 #>  checkmate     68.53        74.20     5.67       8.3 #>      mixed     31.02        36.74     5.71      18.4

code: library(argvet)  fit <- function(name, threads = 2) {   # checks   rlang::check_string(name)   rlang::check_number_decimal(threads, lower = 1, upper = 64)   if (!is.integer(threads)) {     rlang::abort("`threads` must be an integer.")   }    # actual work   message("Fitting model ", name, " with ", threads, " threads.") } fit("my_model", threads = 4L) #> Fitting model my_model with 4 threads. check_fit <- function(   name,   threads,   arg_1,   arg_2,   arg_3,   arg_4,   ... ) {   # checks   rlang::check_dots_empty()   rlang::check_string(name)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_1)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_2)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_3)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_4)   rlang::check_number_decimal(threads, lower = 1, upper = 64)   if (!is.integer(threads)) {     rlang::abort("`threads` must be an integer.")   } }  fit_v2 <- function(   name,   threads = 2,   arg_1,   arg_2,   arg_3,   arg_4,   ... ) {   check_fit(name, threads, arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, ...)   # actual work   message("Fitting model ", name, " with ", threads, " threads.") } fit_v2("my_model", threads = 4L, arg_1 = 1, arg_2 = 2, arg_3 = 3, arg_4 = 4) #> Fitting model my_model with 4 threads. check_fit <- make_arg_validator({   # checks   rlang::check_dots_empty()   rlang::check_string(name)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_1)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_2)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_3)   rlang::check_number_decimal(arg_4)   rlang::check_number_decimal(threads, lower = 1, upper = 64)   if (!is.integer(threads)) {     rlang::abort("`threads` must be an integer.")   } })  fit_v2 <- function(   name,   threads = 2,   arg_1,   arg_2,   arg_3,   arg_4,   ... ) {   check_fit()   # actual work   message("Fitting model ", name, " with ", threads, " threads.") } fit_v2("my_model", threads = 4L, arg_1 = 1, arg_2 = 2, arg_3 = 3, arg_4 = 4) #> Fitting model my_model with 4 threads. # This will fail because there is an extra argument. fit_v2(   "my_model",   threads = 4L,   arg_1 = 1,   arg_2 = 2,   arg_3 = 3,   arg_4 = 4,   extra_arg = 5 ) |>   try() #> Error : `...` must be empty. #> ✖ Problematic argument: #> • extra_arg = 5 check_fit <- make_arg_validator({   # checks   chk::chk_integer(threads)   chk::chk_string(name)   checkmate::assert(     checkmate::checkCount(arg_1),     checkmate::checkCount(arg_2),     checkmate::checkCount(arg_3),     checkmate::checkCount(arg_4),     combine = "and"   ) })   fit_v2("my_model", threads = 4L, arg_1 = 1, arg_2 = 2, arg_3 = 3, arg_4 = 4) #> Fitting model my_model with 4 threads. fit_v2(   "my_model",   threads = 4,   arg_1 = 1,   arg_2 = 2,   arg_3 = 3,   arg_4 = 4 ) |>   try() #> Error : `threads` must be integer.  fit_v2(   "my_model",   threads = 4L,   arg_1 = 1.2, # code: # ---- 1. Check the arguments, then use the validated values --------------- validate_add <- make_arg_validator({   if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L) {     rlang::abort("`x` must be a single number.", call = NULL)   }   if (!is.numeric(y) || length(y) != 1L) {     rlang::abort("`y` must be a single number.", call = NULL)   } })  add <- function(x, y) {   args <- validate_add()   args$x + args$y }  add(1, 2) #> [1] 3 #> [1] 3  # validation errors keep their message and reach the caller unchanged tryCatch(add("a", 2), error = function(cnd) conditionMessage(cnd)) #> [1] "`x` must be a single number." #> [1] "`x` must be a single number."  # ---- 2. Coerce first, write the result back into the calling frame ------- validate_ratio <- make_arg_validator({   numerator <- as.numeric(numerator)   denominator <- as.numeric(denominator)   if (denominator == 0) {     rlang::abort("`denominator` must not be zero.", call = NULL)   } })  ratio <- function(numerator, denominator) {   list2env(validate_ratio(), envir = environment())   numerator / denominator }  ratio("3", 2) #> [1] 1.5 #> [1] 1.5  tryCatch(ratio(1, 0), error = function(cnd) conditionMessage(cnd)) #> [1] "`denominator` must not be zero." #> [1] "`denominator` must not be zero."  # ---- 3. Share one validator between several functions -------------------- validate_draw <- make_arg_validator({   color <- match.arg(color, c("red", "green", "blue"))   size <- max(size, 1) })  draw_point <- function(x, y, color = "red", size = 0) {   args <- validate_draw()   sprintf(     "point (%s, %s) color=%s size=%s", x, y, args$color, args$size   ) }  draw_point(1, 2, color = "green", size = 0) #> [1] "point (1, 2) color=green size=1" #> [1] "point (1, 2) color=green size=1"  # ---- 4. Only bindings that already existed are returned ------------------ validate_scale <- make_arg_validator({   span <- max(x) - min(x)   x <- (x - min(x)) / span })  scale01 <- function(x) validate_scale()  scale01(c(0, 5, 10)) #> $x #> [1] 0.0 0.5 1.0 #>  #> $x #> [1] 0.0 0.5 1.0 # `span` was created inside the expression, so it is not part of the result  # ---- 5. Validate an environment directly --------------------------------- validate_opts <- make_arg_validator({   name <- trimws(name)   threads <- as.integer(threads) })  opts <- list2env(list(name = "  model  ", threads = "4")) validate_opts(opts) #> $name #> [1] "model" #>  #> $threads #> [1] 4 #>  #> $name #> [1] "model" #> #> $threads #> [1] 4  # ---- 6. Local temporaries are captured as well --------------------------- validate_pos <- make_arg_validator({   if (x <= 0) {     rlang::abort("`x` must be positive.", call = NULL)   } })  sqrt_checked <- function(x) {   tmp <- "not an argument"   args <- validate_pos()   names(args) }  sqrt_checked(4) #> [1] "tmp" "x"   #> [1] "tmp" "x"  # ---- 7. Classed conditions can be caught --------------------------------- validate_n <- make_arg_validator({   if (!is.numeric(n)) {     rlang::abort(       "`n` must be numeric.",       class = "rpkgkit_bad_n",       call = NULL     )   } })  count_up <- function(n) validate_n()  tryCatch(   count_up("a"),   rpkgkit_bad_n = function(cnd) "caught a classed error" ) #> [1] "caught a classed error" #> [1] "caught a classed error"  # ---- 8. `...` is forwarded to `expr` but never returned ------------------ validate_no_dots <- make_arg_validator({   rlang::check_dots_empty() })  strict <- function(x, ...) validate_no_dots()  strict(1) #> $x #> [1] 1 #>  #> $x #> [1] 1  # the dots check sees the caller's `...`, not an empty environment tryCatch(strict(1, 2), rlib_error_dots_nonempty = function(cnd) "dots seen") #> [1] "dots seen" #> [1] "dots seen"  validate_dots <- make_arg_validator({   if (...length() > 2L) {     rlang::abort("at most two values are supported.", call = NULL)   } })  pick <- function(x, ...) validate_dots()  tryCatch(pick(1, 2, 3, 4), error = function(cnd) conditionMessage(cnd)) #> [1] "at most two values are supported." #> [1] "at most two values are supported."
